basic_info.description: This exquisitely renovated home blends modern luxury with breathtaking, unobstructed cityscape views. No expense was spared in the top-to-bottom renovation, which pairs expert craftsmanship with contemporary design and resort-style amenities. Seismically upgraded, the home features a striking, lighted circular staircase with a custom steel banister as a central architectural element.    The open-concept main level offers updated flooring and freshly painted interiors, anchored by a charming wood-burning fireplace. Oversized panoramic windows and sliding doors connect the living space to one of three expansive decks, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor experience that includes a built-in bar/kitchen pass-through and an endless lap pool.    A chef's dream, the remodeled gourmet kitchen features high-end appliances, sleek cabinetry, and a generous island perfect for entertaining. Each bedroom includes custom-designed closets, while the luxurious primary suite boasts a spacious walk-in closet with built-in organizers and a spa-like bath complete with a freestanding soaking tub.    Additional highlights include 4-zone hydronic radiant floor heating, owned solar panels, a finished garage with a pet washing station, and a convenient bonus half bath.
